limits.title: What the tool does not do
limits.intro: Said here rather than discovered in use.
limits.history: PremadeLab collects each player's last {{maxGames}} games, from the last {{maxAgeDays}} days at most, or their last {{minGames}} if they rarely play. Older history is not collected.
limits.noWorldStats: No worldwide average: comparisons are made with players of the same tier, from the games PremadeLab collected itself, and every figure says how many games it covers.
limits.noProbe: The page of a looked-up player only shows what Riot makes public: rank, champions and games. Team notes and compositions stay reserved to team members.
limits.noLive: Nothing live: no in-game tracking, no overlay, no interaction with the game client.
limits.collectTime: The first collection takes time — the Riot API quota limits it. The profile screen says how far along it is.
limits.historyUnknown: PremadeLab only collects each player's recent games: older history is not collected.

legal.title: Notices
legal.data: What PremadeLab keeps, for how long, and how to request its deletion is described in the privacy policy.

duo.question: How can I see my duo's stats in League of Legends?
duo.answer: Create a team with your duo on PremadeLab. The games you play together are found automatically, and the Strategy tab compares your win rate together with what each of you does without the other.

premade.question: How can I find my premade's win rate?
premade.answer: Add your group's Riot IDs to a team. A game counts as a team game as soon as four members play it together, whatever the mode, and the record is on the team page.

games.question: Which games are analysed?
games.answer: The recent games Riot makes public for each account, in every queue. Per-minute indicators only cover Summoner's Rift: ranked, normal and Clash.

free.question: Is PremadeLab free?
free.answer: Yes. Player profiles can be viewed without an account, and a Discord login is enough to build a team.

reference.title: Reference distances
reference.description: As the crow flies between landmarks, walking time at {{speed}} movement speed. The button shows the route on the map.

method.title: How it is measured
method.sources: Towers and inhibitors sit at the positions recorded in the games PremadeLab collects, identical from one game to the next. Fountains, camps, scuttle crabs, Baron and Dragon come from the game’s map files. Only the nexus is estimated. The red side is not an exact mirror of the blue side: each landmark is recorded where it stands.
method.units: Distances are in game units, the ones used by spell ranges and movement speed. The map is about 15,000 units across.
method.straight: A distance is measured as the crow flies. Walking time is therefore a minimum: walls make the real path longer, and speed changes with the champion, boots and bonuses.
